text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Mar 28th, 2018 // No Comments 
Chelsea Counsel Co. reduced its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8.0% during the 4th quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The fund owned 53,179 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 4,602 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 4.8% of Chelsea Counsel Co.’s portfolio, making the stock its 5th biggest holding. Chelsea Counsel Co.’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,999,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Other large investors have also modified their holdings of the company. Beach Investment Management LLC. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 1,517.7% in the second quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,651,000 after buying an additional 167,099 shares during the period. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 8,719.3% in the second quarter. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC now owns 384,344 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $55,353,000 after buying an additional 379,986 shares during the period. First Capital Advisors Group LLC. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 1.6% in the second quarter. First Capital Advisors Group LLC. now owns 16,639 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,396,000 after buying an additional 255 shares during the period. Teacher Retirement System of Texas lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 0.7% in the second quarter. Teacher Retirement System of Texas now owns 3,279,408 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $472,300,000 after buying an additional 24,352 shares during the period. Finally, Smith Asset Management Group LP lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 5.3% in the second quarter. Smith Asset Management Group LP now owns 693,701 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $99,907,000 after buying an additional 34,640 shares during the period. 61.35% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. Several equities research analysts recently weighed in on the stock. UBS set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday. Vetr cut shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $191.74 target price for the company. in a research note on Monday. Bank of America reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $220.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 23rd. Nomura reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, March 19th. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 16th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.70. In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of Apple stock opened at $168.34 on Wednesday. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $140.06 and a fifty-two week high of $183.50. The company has a market cap of $836,907.75, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.30, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.25 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business earned $3.36 EPS. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.38 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
